d: Heidi and Spencer's behavior cause their friends & family to make a difficult choice.  Kristin and Brody hook up but agree to stay single.  Ryan disappoints Audrina when he doesn't show for a night out.
Brody puts his friendship with Kristin on the line when he starts seeing another girl.  Lo sets Stephanie up on a double date.  Ryan gives Audrina's friends another chance.
Kristin has a hard time moving on from Brody.  Audrina bumps into Justin and starts to have doubts about her relationship with Ryan.  Lo befriends Brody's new girlfriend.

Brody's new love interest makes an enemy of Kristin when she brings an old rival of Kristin's to a party.  Ryan comes back from tour, but Audrina doesn't tell him that she saw Justin while he was away.
Audrina's relationship with Ryan is put to the test when he meets Justin for the first time.  Brody sides with Kristin when Allie picks a fight with her.  Stephanie has a disappointing second date.
Just as Audrina ends things with Ryan, Justin surprises her on her birthday.  McKaela's friend Allie stirs up more trouble with Kristin.  Brody gives Justin a piece of his mind.

On a group surf trip to Costa Rica, Kristin makes Brody jealous by hooking up with a local bartender, Audrina fights her attraction to Justin, and Stephanie finds herself at odds with the jungle environment.

Kristin has a heart-to-heart with Brody, she wants to give their relationship another shot.  Heidi's mother comes to LA, hoping to reconcile with her.  Lo and her boyfriend celebrate their anniversary, and Stephanie starts seeing someone new.

Kristin will have to decide if she's going to make a major change in her life, which may force Brody to make a decision about their relationship.  Audrina chooses a new, independent life without Justin, but will that be the right choice?
Their senior year is winding down and the kids from Laguna Beach are just getting started for their summer of fun...and drama.
The love triangle between Stephen, Kristin, and LC is becoming more obvious, and each of them is really starting to feel the pressure.
When LC, Stephen and Trey check out a designer fashion show in LA, LC watches Stephen's attention turn from fashion to fashion models.

When Morgan throws Christina an 18th-birthday bash, she cuts LC and Lo from the guest list, so bumping into them the next day at the nail salon was sweet irony.  Christina and Morgan then head to NYC for their spring break trip.
